prompt: Use the provided painting as the approved reference for the bird and the painting style, and paint the same red-crowned crane again, now at rest: a museum-quality sumi-e ink painting on plain warm rice paper of one red-crowned crane standing still on two thin legs at the edge of shallow water, seen from the side, facing left, its long neck in a gentle S curve and its head turned slightly down, calm and settled, wings folded against the body. The bird is centred and fills about three quarters of the frame's height, with clear empty paper margins all round and nothing cut off. Plain empty rice paper ground (#F6F3EC), evenly lit. No mountains, no mist, no sun, no lines, no text, no seal, no signature, no border. Nothing red anywhere.
